title: Exploratory study: new tabular models, hierarchical target encoding, alternative objectives (IR.csv 113-2)
status_of_results: EXPLORATORY ONLY. IR.csv has already been used repeatedly for model selection; no result here is confirmatory and none supports next-year or cross-college claims. The existing metadata NO-GO decision is not revisited.

data.frame: research primary frame: term 113-2, ambiguous zero grades excluded (83,494 rows); zero-grade sensitivity uses the 85,567-row frame
derived_registration_time: course_family (from the normalised course name; no grades)
forbidden: student_id or any per-student grade proxy
export-scope artefacts (course_code, offering_class, hours, student_class, grade_level)

protocols.folds: 5-fold GroupKFold, seed 42, identical to research/validation.py (student/section/course) and research/family (family)
populations: family split: rows of single-course families (genuinely unseen courses)
protocols.inner_folds: every preprocessing step, encoder, early-stopping split and tuning step uses only the outer training fold, grouped by the same unit as the outer split

frozen_baselines.reuse: out-of-fold predictions from research/advanced phase 1 are reused only if CatBoost on the student split is recomputed bit-for-bit
frozen_baselines.comparator: per protocol, the frozen baseline with the lower MAE (the strongest comparator)

candidates.A1_tabm: official `tabm` 0.0.3 TabM.make(k=32, default backbone); in-fold QuantileTransformer for numerics, integer codes for categoricals (levels with < 5 training rows and unseen levels -> UNK); AdamW lr 2e-3, wd 3e-4, batch 512, max 30 epochs, early stopping patience 5 on a 10% grouped inner validation split; target standardised; mean over the k heads
candidates.A2_ft_transformer: official `rtdl_revisiting_models` 0.0.2 FTTransformer with get_default_kwargs(n_blocks=2) and make_default_optimizer(); same preprocessing and early stopping as A1
candidates.B1_hte_lightgbm: LightGBM; course_key replaced by group-aware hierarchical target encodings (category -> family -> course, smoothing m selected in-fold from {5, 20, 100} by 3-fold inner grouped CV) + training-row counts
candidates.B2_hte_catboost: CatBoost with the B1 encodings (same in-fold m)
candidates.B3_hte_plus_cat_lightgbm: LightGBM with course_key categorical AND the B1 encodings
candidates.B4_missing_lightgbm: frozen LightGBM + indicators available at prediction time: required_elective missing, course seen in training, family seen in training (training-row indicators computed out-of-fold like the encodings)
candidates.C1_ebm: InterpretML ExplainableBoostingRegressor (interpret-core 0.7.8), defaults except outer_bags=4, random_state=42; categoricals as strings
candidates.C2_ngboost: NGBoost 0.5.11, Normal distribution, DecisionTreeRegressor(max_depth=4), 400 estimators, lr 0.05, early stopping 20 rounds on a 10% grouped inner validation split; inputs = B1 encodings (m=20) + ordinal codes of low-cardinality categoricals + numerics; point prediction = mean

endpoints.primary: paired MAE difference MAE(best frozen baseline) - MAE(candidate) per protocol (4) and on single-course families (family split), group-level bootstrap by the split's grouping unit
secondary: MAE per course_category / student_college / program and the worst group
wall-clock seconds per fit and in total

bootstrap.multiplicity: Bonferroni over 13 candidates x 5 comparisons = 65: adjusted two-sided level 1 - 0.05/65

zero_grade_sensitivity: frozen baselines, C3-C6, and the best A and best B candidate (by mean primary difference) on the zero-inclusive frame, student and family splits; MAE on zero and non-zero rows

decision_rule.exploratory_signal: Bonferroni-adjusted CI lower bound > 0 and gain >= 0.05 on >= 2 of the 4 protocols, AND 95% CI upper bound >= 0 (not significantly worse) on every protocol and on single-course families
decision_rule.interpretation: a signal only nominates a candidate for confirmation on future, independent semesters; it is never reported as validated performance

budget_and_stopping.compute: CPU only (the GPUs are occupied by other users' jobs); 32 threads
budget_and_stopping.on_cap: a fit that exceeds its cap is stopped and recorded as budget_exceeded; its candidate is reported as incomplete, never re-run with a bigger budget
budget_and_stopping.no_second_round: no post-hoc tuning, new candidates or re-runs after results are seen; failures are recorded, not retried beyond one automatic retry for transient errors
budget_and_stopping.stop_after: all 13 candidates evaluated once on the 4 protocols, or the total cap reached
budget_and_stopping.non_interruptible_fits: GBM / EBM / NGBoost fits cannot be interrupted safely; a fit whose wall-clock exceeds the per-fit cap is recorded as budget_exceeded and its candidate is excluded from the decision
